public_rationale: OpenAI acknowledged that GPT-5 still hallucinated in September 2025. That directly supports the ordinary reading that plausible false answers remained a problem. The source also reports improvement; Marcus's sentence does not claim that accuracy failed to improve.
limitations: This establishes persistence, not a uniform error rate across models or tasks.
